name: Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund - Euro Share Class
oneLiner: EURSPKCC is the EUR share of Spiko's Digital Assets Cash & Carry fund, a French FPS combining crypto basis-trade exposure with short-duration T-bills.
collateral: Euro share class of the Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund, combining systematic cash-and-carry exposure with short-duration cash and Treasury-bill collateral.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share class; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko fund-transfer rails.

oracleRisk.summary: EURSPKCC publishes its euro-denominated fund NAV through a permissioned Spiko AggregatorV3-compatible oracle; the fund reports profit and loss daily, so this is a single administrative valuation path rather than a live liquidation feed.

branchApplicability.rationale: EURSPKCC represents shares in one professionally managed cash-and-carry fund. Investors submit fund-share redemption requests that an authorized operator executes by burning the shares; they do not open borrower-specific collateral positions, and the reviewed contracts expose no permissionless liquidation markets to split into branches.

jurisdiction.license: French Fonds Professionnel Specialise (FPS) / Alternative Investment Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: EURSPKCC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: eurSPKCC mint is gated by a Spiko PermissionManager on every chain. On Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum and Base the token's mint selector accepts group 0 (a 3/8 Safe on Ethereum, 3/6 elsewhere) or group 2, whose members are Spiko's two-step Minter contract (5,000,000 eurSPKCC daily limit, initiator + approver) and the Chainlink CCIP BurnWithFromMintTokenPool, itself owned by an EOA. Starknet mint requires MINTER_ROLE, held by a 3/5 Argent multisig plus three single-key accounts. Stellar mint requires the MINTER role, held by three single-key accounts, and the owner is a single-key account that can upgrade the wasm. Cross-chain the Safe-gated EVM admin is the bound; Starknet and Stellar are single-key surfaces.

review.evidence: Every chain in the coin file was read on-chain. EVM (Ethereum 25530961, Polygon 90218705, Arbitrum 483768450, Base 48621853): PermissionManager.getRequirements(token, mint) = groups {0,2} on all four; group membership enumerated from the complete GroupAdded/GroupRemoved log history (Blockscout etherscan-compatible logs API) and every candidate re-checked with getGroups() at head. Group 0 = Spiko admin Safe (3/8 on Ethereum, 3/6 on Polygon/Arbitrum/Base, all Safe v1.4.1, no modules, no guard); group 2 = the Spiko Minter proxy (dailyLimit 500000000000, initiator group 10 + approver group 9) and the Chainlink CCIP BurnWithFromMintTokenPool for each Spiko fund token, all owned by EOA 0xEd608cf3.... Starknet (block 11841234): MINTER_ROLE holders enumerated from a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked scan and confirmed with has_role — a 3/5 ArgentMultisig plus three single-key accounts. Stellar (Soroban ledger 63473407): the PermissionManager is enumerable, get_role_member(MINTER, 0..2) returns three accounts, and Horizon shows all three plus the owner/admin are single-signer accounts. Upgradeability: all four EVM token proxies are UUPS (EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0) and getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall) = group {0}, so the admin Safe can replace mint logic; Ethereum/Polygon/Base share implementation 0x15ea0ec4..., Arbitrum runs 0xa0769f7a...; the Starknet class is OZ-Upgradeable and owner-gated (simulated upgrade from the 3/5 Argent multisig succeeds) and the Soroban wasm upgrade is owner-gated to single-key account GBYIQXBK... (simulated upgrade succeeds for the owner, fails for a MINTER holder). The open question about the non-Ethereum deployments is resolved and removed. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: the official product page identifies CACEIS as depositary and accountant and states that PwC performs recurring statutory audits, but it still showed allocation data last updated 2025-11-21 and exposed no dated PwC report or other current independent supply-to-assets reconciliation. Those role and cadence claims do not establish a qualifying recurring report, so reconciliation remains unknown. The exact AMF GECO registry evidence is retained in the sources, but supervision is intentionally not authored while reconciliation evidence is absent.

reserveReview.rationale: The current eurSPKCC public share-class API exposes one 100% Digital-asset cash-and-carry strategy slice. The exact strategy positions, counterparties, custody, and any Treasury or cash overlay are not published as a current constituent allocation, so the live slice is retained as one bounded protocol-position row rather than preserving an unsupported 80/20 split.
